SUMMARY
The home sits in a quiet cul-de-sac location within this sought-after residential close. Aigburth is a highly desirable suburb with excellent local amenities, parks, good schools, and convenient transport links into Liverpool city centre.

DESCRIPTION
Detached family home in the popular Aigburth area of Liverpool, offering approximately 116 square metres of versatile living space. This property benefits from a driveway providing off-road parking and a single garage with internal access. There is a welcoming porch leading into the hall and a useful guest WC on the ground floor. The accommodation includes a spacious living room and a separate dining room, along with a kitchen/breakfast area that opens into a bright conservatory, creating an ideal space for family meals or entertaining. Upstairs, the first floor provides three good-sized bedrooms and family bathroom facilities. The layout offers excellent flow for modern family living, with distinct reception spaces on the ground floor and private bedroom accommodation above. The home sits in a quiet cul-de-sac location within this sought-after residential close. Aigburth is a highly desirable suburb with excellent local amenities, parks, good schools, and convenient transport links into Liverpool city centre.
